about: Shows one panel at a time, chosen from a strip of controls.

fitted.about: Controls taking what they need, and controls sharing the strip's width between them.
fitted.title: Fitted

justify.about: Where the controls sit in a strip they do not fill.
justify.title: Distribution

orientation.about: The strip across the top, and down the side. Which way it runs is the machine's setting, not an axis, and the bar follows it.
orientation.title: Orientation

size.about: Every step the strip is read at. The step sets the tab, the words on it and the room round them.
size.title: Sizes

title: Tabs

variant.about: Every look, one under another so each set is read at the width a strip of tabs is given.
variant.title: Looks
